# Release notes — Shop 1.4

Released 2026-11-20.

## New

- Gift wrapping can now be added at checkout (#44).
- Your cart is saved between visits, so it is still there when you come back (#46).

## Fixes

- Coupon codes are no longer case sensitive (#41).
- The total is now correct for empty carts (#42).

## Improvements

- Prices are shown with two decimals everywhere (#43).
- The product list is loaded in a single query, so pages with many products load faster (#45).

## Under the hood

- Bumped the test timeout.
- Removed an unused import.
